- **Model**: One-time purchase, lifetime license, white-label deployment.
- **Price**: ₹20,000 INR (flat one-time fee).
- **Recurring Cost**: ₹0 forever (no monthly, no yearly, no per-flat or per-tenant fees).
- **Target Audience**: Indian property owners with 5 to 50 rental units (residential flats, PG/hostel rooms, commercial shopping complexes, mixed-use buildings).
- **Live Reference Property**: Arya Plaza, Munger, Bihar, India (Live web portal: https://aryaplaza.vercel.app).

## 2. Capability Matrix (Verified from Source Code)
| Feature Area | Tenant Companion App | Owner Admin Console |
|---|---|---|
| Live rent balance & dues | View | Manage |
| Lease terms & plain-language deal summary | View | Configure |
| Advance deposit & top-ups | View | Manage |
| Payment ledger & installments | Report (Cash, UPI) | Confirm & Reconcile |
| Direct 0% commission UPI handoff | 1-Tap Pay | Verify & Confirm |
| Rent escalation tiers (step-up) | View | Configure |
| Maintenance requests | Create & track | Resolve |
| Utility sub-meter billing (electricity / water) | View history & tariffs | Calculate & publish |
| Notices & announcements | Read | Publish |
| Gate passes & visitor logs | Generate & use | Administer & approve |
| Weekly 4-meal mess menus (PG / hostels) | Read daily menu | Publish & edit |
| English & हिन्दी bilingual localization | 1-Tap toggle | 1-Tap toggle |
| Cloud dynamic rebranding (zero recompile) | Live sync | Palette & logo customizer |
| Biometric & 6-digit PIN lockout | Unlock | Enforce & reset |
| Multi-property switching | Contextual | Yes (full switcher) |
| PDF / CSV / Excel reports | PDF receipt | Yes (exportable ledgers) |
| In-app OTA updates | Receive & install | Publish release package |

## 3. Core Architectural Subsystems
- **Frontend Applications**: Two native Flutter applications (Tenant and Admin) compiled to Android APKs (minSdk 21, targetSdk 34).
- **Backend Infrastructure**: Google Firebase (Spark Free Tier).
  - **Firebase Authentication**: Phone number / email authentication with local 6-digit PIN biometric lock.
  - **Cloud Firestore**: Real-time NoSQL streaming database.
  - **Firestore Security Rules**: Role-based access control enforcing owner administrative boundaries and tenant lease-level data isolation.
  - **Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)**: Push notifications and rent reminders.
- **White-Label Deployment Engine**:
  - Controlled by central `client_config.json`.
  - Automated launcher icon and Android splash screen generation.
  - Automatic Firebase API key and project discovery via `google-services.json`.
  - One-click release compilation for both client APKs.

## 4. Cost Math & Economic Comparison
- **Rentlyo**: ₹20,000 flat upfront. No server bill (Firebase Spark free tier includes 50,000 reads/day and 20,000 writes/day; 25-unit properties consume < 10% of quota).
- **Subscription Alternatives (SaaS)**:
  - Average Indian property SaaS: ₹79/unit/month or ₹1,499 flat/month.
  - 1-Year cost: ₹17,988.
  - 3-Year cost: ₹53,964.
  - 5-Year cost: ₹89,940.
  - 5-Year Rentlyo Net Savings: ₹69,940+.
